dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Ah, Lesser Lord Kusanali be praised! My thanks to you two, many thanks indeed!

choices.text: Could you remind me how to use this pot again?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Right, yes, of course. A great hero such as yourself is rather busy, after all, perhaps too busy to remember such things. I did not consider that.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: It's actually quite simple. You simply need to add the correct seasonings at the right time.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I'm sure you'll work it out once you try it.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: See you. Once again, you have Nazafarin's utmost thanks! May this go smoothly for you.
